InfoBlock1.title: About Our Company
InfoBlock1.content: For more than five years we’ve specialised in professional cleaning and disinfection of wall-mounted AC units across the Gush Dan area. Our certified technicians use only high-quality hypoallergenic products and advanced equipment to ensure maximum efficiency and total safety for your home or office.

InfoBlock2.title: Why Your AC Needs Regular Cleaning

line1.title: Air Quality & Health
line1.content: Dust, mould, bacteria and allergens build up inside the unit. Without yearly cleaning they spread throughout the room, causing respiratory irritation, frequent colds and allergic reactions.

line2.title: Energy Efficiency
line2.content: Clogged filters and evaporator coils make the compressor work harder, raising electricity use by 10–25 %. Regular maintenance cuts power bills and extends system life.

line3.title: Longer Service Life
line3.content: Dirt hampers the fan and heat-exchanger; parts wear out faster and gas leaks or noise may appear. Professional cleaning protects components and adds years to your AC.

steps.title: Inspection & Disassembly
steps.content: Technician arrives at the agreed time, disconnects power and carefully removes filters, cover and internal parts.

steps.title: Internal Component Cleaning
steps.content: Filters are washed and sanitised with hypoallergenic agents. The evaporator coil is steamed or gently pressure-washed to remove dust and mould.

steps.title: Drainage System Flush
steps.content: Drain channels and condensate tray are rinsed to prevent clogs, standing water and odours.

steps.title: Outdoor Unit Clean-up
steps.content: The condenser coil and fan are cleared of dirt with high-pressure water. Fins are checked and debris removed.

steps.title: Sanitising & Reassembly
steps.content: Internal parts are treated with an antiseptic solution, reassembled, filters installed and the AC’s operation tested.

ServiceArea.title: Service Area
ServiceArea.content: We cover central Israel from Ashdod to Hadera, with rapid call-outs to: Tel-Aviv-Yafo, Rishon LeZion, Petah Tikva, Netanya, Bnei Brak, Ashdod, Holon, Ramat Gan, Rehovot, Bat Yam, Herzliya, Hadera and nearby towns. If your location isn’t listed, check with us by phone or the online form.

items.title: Fast Response
items.content: We guarantee arrival within 24 hours on business days. Weekends and holidays by appointment (extra charge).

items.title: Safe Products
items.content: All cleaning agents are hypoallergenic – no harsh acids or toxic chemicals.

items.title: Transparent Pricing
items.content: No hidden fees. Clients inside Gush Dan pay no travel surcharge.

items.title: Skilled Technicians
items.content: Our team consists of certified pros with 3+ years’ experience, up-to-date methods and advanced equipment.

items.title: Office Units (≥8 h/day)
items.content: Twice a year (spring and late summer) to prevent overload and bacterial growth.

items.title: Households with Allergy Sufferers or Young Children
items.content: Every six months for maximum safety.
